findings.title: The CMLJ-V1-B1 landing locator still names summary.leftoverDesign, a list this artifact's own central act empties of OBL-OD-2
findings.finding: findingDisposition[0] is the ACCEPTED disposition of CMLJ-V1-B1, the v1 MUST-FIX raised because the DR-103 partition silently dropped schemas.v11 OD-2. Its landedAt array names two paths where that accepted repair is carried: 'obligations.OBL-OD-2' and 'summary.leftoverDesign'. The first resolves. The second does not: this artifact's summary.leftoverDesign is exactly [OBL-WINDOWS-PATH, OBL-ENVELOPE-MISMATCH, OBL-UNICODE-NORM, OBL-OD-1], and OBL-OD-2 is absent from it by the deliberate act this successor exists to perform. The repair is in fact carried at summary.specifiedNotLeftover, which the locator does not name. Across the whole lineage this locator resolved: v2, v3, v4, v6, v8 and v9 each carry OBL-OD-2 in summary.leftoverDesign, and every other landedAt path in this artifact resolves to a live location that carries its repair. v10 is the first version in which a landedAt path is contradicted by the subject's own bytes, and it is contradicted by v10's own change.

findings.title: A bare 'leftover-join.v6' now collides with g15-leftover-join.v6, which this successor newly pins as a first-class input, inside a sentence whose whole context is G15
findings.finding: basedOn.occupancyV9.role reads: 'Current G15 occupancy remasurement. leftover-join.v6 cited occupancy v7 as the specification.' The token 'leftover-join.v6' carries no lineage prefix. In this artifact two first-class pinned inputs answer to that exact token: basedOn.predecessorV6 = docs/coop/artifacts/component-manifest-leftover-join.v6.json (9953f969…) and basedOn.g15JoinV6 = docs/coop/artifacts/g15-leftover-join.v6.json (4b2ac34c…). The collision is created by this version: v9 pinned g15 leftover-join.v5, not v6, so the identical carried sentence had one referent there and has two here. The misreading is not self-refuting, which is what makes it a defect rather than a nit: g15-leftover-join.v6's own bytes mention 'occupancy v7' five times, and its own basedOn.occupancyV9.role uses the same template sentence about its own lineage's v3. A reader who resolves the bare token to the G15 join — the natural resolution given the sentence's subject is G15 occupancy and the sentence sits in the G15-occupancy custody entry — lands on a false proposition: g15 leftover-join.v6 is D-290, recorded after occupancy v9 (D-214), and does not cite occupancy v7 as its specification.

CMLJ-V7-SF1 was a SHOULD-FIX for one bare 'v6' at basedOn.windowsPathV1.role on exactly this reasoning — 'component-manifest-fixture-corpus.v6 and component-manifest-leftover-join.v6 are both first-class pinned inputs' — and the repair landed at v8.
